sources.snippet: Announcement: ALBEF is now officially integrated into LAVIS - a one-stop library for language-and-vision research and applications! This is the official PyTorch implementation of the ALBEF paper [Blog].

sources.title: salesforce/albef | Readme and Docs - Replicate
sources.snippet: This is the official PyTorch implementation of the ALBEF paper [Blog]. This repository supports pre-training on custom datasets, as well as finetuning on VQA, SNLI-VE, NLVR2, Image-Text Retrieval on MSCOCO and Flickr30k, and visual grounding on RefCOCO+.
